📦 CREATED FILES & COMPONENTS:
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

1. ENVIRONMENT SETUP
   ✅ environment.yml (491 bytes)
      - Python 3.9, PyTorch 2.0.1, MONAI 1.2.0
      - OpenCV, scikit-image, SimpleITK
      - Azure ML SDK
      - All medical imaging dependencies

2. PIPELINE EXECUTION SCRIPTS (8 Python + 2 Bash files)

   📊 Data Processing & Analysis:
   ✅ run_l3_vfa_pma.py (13 KB)
      - L3 slice detection via vertebra center
      - Rule-based VFA/PMA calculation from HU thresholds
      - DL model integration (if available)
      - Hybrid blend (50% rule-based + 50% DL)
      - PNG overlay generation
      - JSON results output

   🧠 Deep Learning Training:
   ✅ prepare_training_data.py (9.2 KB)
      - AMOS22 NIfTI + TotalSegmentator mask loading
      - L3 slice extraction
      - 3-channel input: HU normalized + TS mask + vertebra
      - 3-channel output: VFA mask + PMA mask + inner abdomen mask
      - 512x512 resize for training
      - 80/20 train/val split with metadata

   ✅ train_unet_model.py (6.6 KB)
      - MONAI U-Net 2D architecture
      - Mixed precision training (autocast + GradScaler)
      - Dice + BCE combined loss
      - AdamW optimizer + CosineAnnealingLR scheduler
      - 60 epoch training with checkpointing
      - Best model saved to best_unet.pt

   📈 Report & Analysis:
   ✅ generate_report.py (11 KB)
      - Rule-based vs Hybrid comparison
      - Statistical analysis (mean, std, min, max)
      - VFA/PMA difference metrics (absolute + percentage)
      - Training history integration
      - Matplotlib visualization (scatter plots + histograms)
      - JSON summary report

   🚀 Pipeline Orchestration:
   ✅ launcher.py (8.7 KB)
      - Azure ML Workspace connection
      - Dataset registration
      - Compute cluster setup
      - 5-step pipeline creation:
        1. VFA/PMA Rule-based Processing
        2. Training Data Preparation
        3. U-Net Model Training
        4. Hybrid VFA/PMA (DL-enhanced)
        5. Report Generation
      - Run submission & monitoring

3. SETUP & CONFIGURATION
   ✅ setup_azure_ml.sh (4.3 KB)
      - Azure subscription/RG validation
      - Workspace creation
      - Storage account + containers
      - AMOS22 & TotalSegmentator upload
      - GPU compute cluster provisioning (NC4as_T4_v3)
      - Automated with clear feedback

   ✅ quick_setup.sh (2.8 KB)
      - Interactive setup wizard
      - Prompts for all parameters
      - Parameter validation & summary
      - Confirmation before execution

   ✅ START_HERE.sh (NEW)
      - Automated orchestration guide
      - Azure CLI/Python verification
      - Setup method selection (interactive/manual/config)
      - Next step recommendations

4. DOCUMENTATION
   ✅ README_PIPELINE.md (5.9 KB)
      - Complete pipeline overview
      - 4-step quickstart guide
      - File structure explanation
      - Customization options
      - Troubleshooting guide
      - Performance estimates

   ✅ pipeline.yml (5.7 KB)
      - Azure ML 5-step pipeline definition
      - Compute specifications (NC4as_T4_v3)
      - Input/output data flows
      - Job dependencies
      - Environment specifications

🎯 PIPELINE WORKFLOW:
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

INPUT: AMOS22 CT NIfTI files + TotalSegmentator abdominal_muscles masks
                    ⬇️
      ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
      │ STEP 1: Rule-based VFA/PMA Processing      │
      │ - L3 detection via vertebra center         │
      │ - Inner abdomen segmentation               │
      │ - HU-based fat/muscle thresholding          │
      │ - Results: JSON + PNG overlays             │
      └─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                    ⬇️
      ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
      │ STEP 2: Prepare Training Data               │
      │ - Extract L3 slices from all cases         │
      │ - Generate 3-channel input/output          │
      │ - Resize to 512x512                        │
      │ - Create 80/20 train/val split             │
      └─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                    ⬇️
      ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
      │ STEP 3: Train U-Net (60 epochs)            │
      │ - MONAI U-Net 2D (3→3 channels)            │
      │ - Mixed precision + gradient scaling       │
      │ - Dice + BCE loss                          │
      │ - Best model checkpoint saved              │
      └─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                    ⬇️
      ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
      │ STEP 4: Hybrid VFA/PMA (DL-enhanced)       │
      │ - Load trained U-Net model                 │
      │ - Run DL inference on L3 slices            │
      │ - Blend: 50% rule-based + 50% DL           │
      │ - Results: JSON + PNG overlays             │
      └─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                    ⬇️
      ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
      │ STEP 5: Generate Report                    │
      │ - Compare rule-based vs hybrid metrics     │
      │ - Statistical analysis                     │
      │ - Visualization plots                      │
      │ - JSON summary report                      │
      └─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                    ⬇️
OUTPUT: VFA/PMA results, trained model, comparison report

⚡ PERFORMANCE CHARACTERISTICS:
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Compute: Azure NC4as_T4_v3 (1x NVIDIA T4 GPU, 16 GB VRAM, 4 vCPUs)
Dataset: AMOS22 (~50 cases for demo, scalable to full 500+ cases)

Timeline (estimated):
  • Rule-based VFA/PMA:    30-60 minutes
  • Data Preparation:      10-20 minutes
  • U-Net Training (60ep): 30-45 minutes (T4 GPU optimal)
  • Hybrid VFA/PMA:        30-60 minutes
  • Report Generation:      5-10 minutes
  ────────────────────────────────────
  • TOTAL:                 ~2-3 hours per full run

Cost estimate (Azure T4):
  • $0.35/hour per compute instance
  • Full pipeline: ~$1-1.50 per run
  • Storage: <$1/month for typical runs

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🚀 QUICK START (4 STEPS):
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

1. Run guided setup:
   chmod +x START_HERE.sh
   ./START_HERE.sh

2. This will:
   ✅ Verify Azure CLI & Python
   ✅ Check Azure credentials
   ✅ Let you choose setup method
   ✅ Create all Azure resources

3. Once setup is done, launch pipeline:
   python launcher.py \
     --subscription_id <YOUR_SUBSCRIPTION> \
     --resource_group <YOUR_RG> \
     --workspace_name l3-vfa-pma-workspace \
     --scripts_dir ./

4. Monitor in Azure Portal:
   https://ml.azure.com

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔧 CUSTOMIZATION OPTIONS:
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Model Training:
  • Epochs: Modify --epochs in train_unet_model.py (default: 60)
  • Batch size: Change --batch_size (default: 8)
  • Learning rate: --learning_rate (default: 1e-4)

Hybrid Blending:
  • Alpha factor: --blend_alpha in run_l3_vfa_pma.py
    - 0.0 = Pure rule-based
    - 0.5 = 50/50 hybrid (default)
    - 1.0 = Pure DL

Data:
  • Max cases: --max_cases in prepare_training_data.py (default: 50)
  • Set to -1 or remove for full dataset

✨ KEY FEATURES:
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

✅ Fully Automated Pipeline
   - 5 sequential steps with dependencies
   - No manual intervention required
   - Error handling & recovery

✅ GPU Acceleration
   - MONAI U-Net on NVIDIA T4
   - Mixed precision training (faster, less VRAM)
   - All compute on Azure (no local bottlenecks)

✅ Reproducibility
   - Deterministic random seeds
   - Configuration versioning
   - Result tracking & comparison

✅ Scalability
   - Easily adjust to full AMOS22 dataset
   - Multi-GPU support ready (modify compute size)
   - Incremental processing possible

✅ Clinical Validation
   - Rule-based + DL hybrid approach
   - Anatomical constraints preserved
   - Statistical comparison built-in
